title: 30M73 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: 30M73 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. About 102 days to harvest, 7 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: 30M73 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2005 as NSIC 2005 Cn 172. Pioneer Hi Bred bred it. It takes about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** anywhere in the country, in the dry season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

30M73 corn takes about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7 t/ha matches the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

rows: Took some damage but held up
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 17 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 74 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant 30M73 corn

It is recommended for anywhere in the country in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Where can I buy seed of 30M73?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
